Initial release of pan-xiaozi-search skill.

- Enables searching for shared cloud storage resources indexed on pan.xiaozi.cc.
- Supports queries for Quark, Baidu, Aliyun, and other network disk resources by title, description, and category.
- Outputs search results in a structured list or table with clickable titles and full resource URLs.
- Provides resource details extraction, including descriptions and access methods, upon user request.
- Clear handling of no-result cases and includes user reminders for third-party link safety.

pan-xiaozi-search 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Enables keyword search for shared cloud storage resources indexed on pan.xiaozi.cc (Quark, Baidu, etc.).
- Presents search results in a clear, structured format with clickable resource links and essential metadata.
- Provides detailed resource info upon user request, including descriptions, access types, and safety reminders.
- Handles zero-result cases gracefully, suggesting users adjust their search terms.
- Strictly follows prompt formatting and safety guidelines; only uses live data from WebFetch, no fabricated results.
